summary.text: Marty Long is a Republican state representative from Ulysses who represents District 124 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists him as Martin Long.
He previously served in the House from 2019 to 2023 and returned to the seat in January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Martin Long was born and lives in Ulysses, Kansas, and graduated from Ulysses High School in 1975.
According to Ballotpedia, his professional experience includes work in the farming and hospitality industry and service as a Grant County Commissioner before his election to the Kansas House in 2018.
Long represented District 124 from 2019 to 2023 and assumed office again on January 13, 2025, succeeding David Younger.

For 2025 and 2026 he is assigned to the Energy, Utilities, and Telecommunications Committee, the Taxation Committee, and the Agriculture and Natural Resources Budget Committee, where he is vice chair.
